Form No. 2
G. 2000-8-29

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
Foreign Section Station,
No. P. O. B... 642.
Dated November 1. 1929）

Subject (in full) Arrival of American Communist.

Made by D. I. Robertson. Forwarded by （手写签名：J. Givens A. C. I.）

Attached is a photograph of Comrade George Beseloff,
who arrived here from America in the s.s. "Mishima Maru"
on 30/9/29.
Beseloff is an American citizen of Russian origin
and is known to have lived at No. 716 1st Avenue, Seattle,
Washington. His intentions were to proceed to Soviet
Russia, via Japan, but he was not allowed to do so by the
Japanese Authorities as during the search of his luggage
he was found in possession of certificates, confirming
his membership in Russian and American Communistic Parties.
He was also found in possession of receipts showing, that
he paid membership fee to the American Section of the
Communistic Party. He now resides at 127 Range Road.

（手写签名：A. Robertson）
D. I.

A/D. C. I.

G. 2000-8-29

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
报告

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事侦缉处登记科
外侨股分处，
邮政信箱号码 P. O. B... 642。
日期：1929 年 11 月 1 日）

事由（全称）：美国共产党员抵沪。

呈报人：D. I. Robertson。转呈人：（手写签名：J. Givens A. C. I.）

随函附上乔治·贝塞洛夫（George Beseloff）同志的照片一张，
该员于 1929 年 9 月 30 日乘“三岛丸”号轮船（s.s. "Mishima Maru"）
自美国抵达此处。
贝塞洛夫系俄裔美国公民，
据悉曾居住于华盛顿州西雅图市第一大道 716 号。其原拟经日本前往苏维埃
俄国，但日本当局不准其成行，因在检查其行李时，
发现其持有证明其加入俄国及美国共产党的证书。
另在其身上发现收据，显示其已向共产党美国支部
缴纳党费。该员现寓居兰路（Range Road）127 号。

（手写签名：A. Robertson）
侦探督察（D. I.）

助理刑事侦缉督察（A/D. C. I.）
